"""design_48A5 모델링 준비 스크립트 (학습/성능 계산 없음).
설계 문제(보고서 참조)에 대해 다음 가정을 적용:
  - cr_peak_48h(미래 창) 피처 제외
  - cr_monitored는 설계대로(admit~discharge)와 tp 시점 가용 버전(admit~tp)을 모두 계산, 기본 적용은 tp 버전
  - tp >= discharge 인 시점 제거, 결과 창 절단 여부(censored_48h) 플래그
  - family_id 결측 시 patient_id로 대체한 split_group 사용
"""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

D = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

p = pd.read_csv(D/"patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D/"admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D/"labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
l = l.merge(a[["admission_id", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
cr = l[l.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")

def kdigo(times, vals, cand_mask):
    """cand_mask 위치의 값 중 KDIGO(48h +0.3 또는 7일 최솟값×1.5) 충족이 있는지."""
    for i in np.where(cand_mask)[0]:
        prev = (times < times[i]) & (times >= times[i] - 168*H)
        if not prev.any(): continue
        if vals[i] >= 1.5*vals[prev].min(): return True
        p48 = prev & (times >= times[i] - 48*H)
        if p48.any() and vals[i] - vals[p48].min() >= 0.3: return True
    return False

cr_by = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}
rows = []
for r in a.itertuples():
    g = cr_by.get(r.admission_id)
    for off in [24, 48, 72, 96, 120, 144, 168]:
        tp = r.admit_time + off*H
        if tp >= r.discharge_time: continue
        row = dict(admission_id=r.admission_id, patient_id=r.patient_id, unit=r.unit,
                   offset_h=off, tp=tp, censored_48h=(tp + 48*H > r.discharge_time),
                   n_cr_whole_adm=0 if g is None else len(g))
        if g is not None:
            # 제외: tp까지 보고된 Cr로 AKI 확인
            gk = g[g.report_time <= tp]
            row["aki_known_by_tp"] = kdigo(gk.collect_time.values, gk.value.values,
                                           np.ones(len(gk), bool))
            # 결과: tp~tp+48h 채취 Cr, 기준 tp-168h~tp 채취
            go = g[(g.collect_time > tp - 168*H) & (g.collect_time <= tp + 48*H)]
            t = go.collect_time.values
            row["aki_48h"] = kdigo(t, go.value.values, t > np.datetime64(tp))
            row["n_cr_outcome_win"] = int((t > np.datetime64(tp)).sum())
        else:
            row.update(aki_known_by_tp=False, aki_48h=False, n_cr_outcome_win=0)
        rows.append(row)
tp_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# 피처 (report_time <= tp 기준; cr_peak_48h 제외)
L = l.merge(tp_df[["admission_id", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
L = L[L.report_time <= L.tp]
def agg(test, how, start=None):
    s = L[L.test == test]
    if start is not None: s = s[s.report_time > s.tp - start*H]
    s = s.sort_values("report_time").groupby(["admission_id", "tp"]).value
    return getattr(s, how)()
F = pd.DataFrame({
    "hgb_min": agg("hemoglobin", "min"), "cr_max_48h": agg("creatinine", "max", 48),
    "bun_last": agg("bun", "last"), "n_cr": agg("creatinine", "count"),
    "k_last": agg("potassium", "last"), "cr_last": agg("creatinine", "last"),
    "cr_min_adm": agg("creatinine", "min")}).reset_index()
X = tp_df.merge(F, on=["admission_id", "tp"], how="left").merge(p, on="patient_id")
X["n_cr"] = X.n_cr.fillna(0)
X["cr_monitored_design"] = X.n_cr_whole_adm >= 3
X["cr_monitored_tp"] = X.n_cr >= 3
X["split_group"] = X.family_id.fillna(X.patient_id)

coh = X[(X.age >= 18) & X.cr_monitored_tp & ~X.aki_known_by_tp].copy()
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.3, random_state=20261002)
tr, te = next(gss.split(coh, groups=coh.split_group))
coh["split"] = "train"; coh.iloc[te, coh.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"
assert not set(coh[coh.split=="train"].split_group) & set(coh[coh.split=="test"].split_group)
assert not set(coh[coh.split=="train"].patient_id) & set(coh[coh.split=="test"].patient_id)

cols = ["admission_id","patient_id","family_id","split_group","split","unit","offset_h","tp",
        "censored_48h","aki_48h","n_cr_outcome_win","age","sex","hgb_min","cr_max_48h",
        "bun_last","n_cr","k_last","cr_last","cr_min_adm"]
coh[cols].to_csv(OUT/"cohort_features.csv.gz", index=False)

# 요약
print("tp 후보(재원 중):", len(tp_df), "| 설계 cr_monitored 통과:", X.cr_monitored_design.sum(),
      "| tp 버전 통과:", X.cr_monitored_tp.sum())
print("최종 코호트 tp:", len(coh), "입원:", coh.admission_id.nunique(), "환자:", coh.patient_id.nunique())
print(coh.groupby("split").agg(n=("tp","size"), adm=("admission_id","nunique"), groups=("split_group","nunique")))
print("결과창 절단 비율:", coh.censored_48h.mean().round(3))
print("결측률:\n", coh[cols[11:]].isna().mean().round(3))
print("층별 결과율/측정빈도:\n", coh.groupby("unit").agg(event_rate=("aki_48h","mean"),
      cr_per_window=("n_cr_outcome_win","mean"), censored=("censored_48h","mean")).round(3))
print("절단 여부별 결과율:\n", coh.groupby("censored_48h").aki_48h.mean().round(3))
# 설계대로 family_id 그룹화 시 문제 확인
print("family_id 결측 비율(코호트 tp):", coh.family_id.isna().mean().round(3))
print("다중 입원 환자 수(코호트):", (coh.groupby("patient_id").admission_id.nunique() > 1).sum())
# cr_monitored 설계 버전과 결과 관계
Xa = X[(X.age>=18)&~X.aki_known_by_tp]
print("설계 cr_monitored 통과/탈락별 결과율:\n", Xa.groupby("cr_monitored_design").aki_48h.mean().round(3))
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/a302ee8eaee8-t1/ws/prep && python3 prepare.py
